data.one_liner: Generate a Dart file with the package version at build time.
data.what_it_does: `build_version` extracts the `version` field from a pubspec and writes it to a Dart file. It can run as a standalone CLI or as a build_runner builder, supporting custom output paths and CI verification.
use_when: You need a compile‑time constant for the package version
You already use build_runner for other generators
You want CI to verify the generated file matches pubspec
avoid_when: You only need the version at runtime and can read pubspec directly
You prefer a pure Dart solution without code generation
strengths: Supports both CLI and build_runner workflows
weaknesses: Adds a build step to the project
Only handles the version field, not other metadata
data.setup_notes: Add `build_version` to dev_dependencies and run `dart run build_runner build` or use the CLI directly. No special permissions needed.

alternatives.name: build_runner
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you already use build_runner for other generators, you can integrate this builder without adding a separate CLI.
